spec.purpose: Isolated parallel exact K16 carry transfer for two, four or eight prepared groups. Fixed alignment sums are eligible only when original product exponents are dominated by a normal incoming FP32 carry. Adjacent four-lane teams compute different K16 groups concurrently; an integer prefix scan joins their increments. Every interior signed significand must remain in the original binade; the final group retains original normalization. Rejected transfers reuse fixed sums only while the actual carry exponent equals the original alignment exponent; all other groups use the existing staged algorithm. Compare every raw K16 significand, exponent and sign and final value against independent original CPU primitives, plus normal/audit parity, encoded words, original inputs and guards. Seven width/row configurations cover partial groups through width8192, unsupported data and ordinary finite inputs. No production dispatcher or model change.

implementation: Adjacent teams of four lanes prepare separate K16 groups of one output. Subwaves of8/16/32 lanes cover2/4/8 groups. An integer prefix scan computes all original fixed-binade increments and checks every interior sign and exponent before final original normalization. Invalid increments contribute zero only to the diagnostic scan and reject the whole window, preventing signed overflow. A declined window reuses its aligned sums only while the actual carry exponent equals the entry exponent; other groups use the unchanged staged accumulator. All original candidates and lossless36-byte rows remain unchanged. No approximate result is admitted.
correctness_scope: Independent original CPU primitives check every significand/exponent/sign and final float in seven generated shapes, including partial windows and unsupported values. Normal and audit kernels agree, all encodings and input words and redzones remain intact. Every full-projection warmup and timed attempt compares all raw outputs with the original staged2 control and all BF16 outputs with the captured gb10 operator reference. This is component evidence only; no prompt or token loop is run.
timing_scope: Complete operand preparation and replay with at most4096 blocks per dispatch. Control/8/16/32-lane candidates per dispatch are262144/131072/65536/32768. One warmup and three rotating samples per variant. Shared matrix production, candidate selection, allocation, output reset and verification are outside the clock. QKV repeats1023 captured input/reference rows; OUT repeats1023 input rows and uses a separately captured full8192 reference.
decision: Keep isolated: no parallel window beats the retained staged2 implementation on both complete projections. All numerical checks pass but the new geometry does not earn product integration.
